# Stratum Cost Segregation
> Residential cost segregation studies for short-term and long-term rental property owners.

## About
Stratum Cost Segregation provides IRS-compliant cost segregation studies for residential real estate investors. We help STR and LTR property owners accelerate depreciation deductions through detailed engineering-based analyses that reclassify building components into shorter MACRS recovery periods.
